jesseovo-last30days-skill-cn-root.description: Research what Chinese internet users actually said in the last 30 days across Weibo, Xiaohongshu (RED), Bilibili, Zhihu, Douyin, WeChat public accounts, Baidu and Toutiao: engagement-weighted ranking, cross-platform clustering, cited Markdown/JSON/HTML reports. Also shows today's cross-platform hot-search board (全网热榜, --hot) and can add Hacker News / GitHub / Reddit or an installed upstream last30days for X/YouTube/TikTok.
